category.description: Reported by the `Traffic category` property. Defaults to 'custom'. A built-in category such as ai_crawler or search_crawler relabels the traffic type too.

combiner.description: How the conditions combine: 'AND' flags an event only when every condition matches, 'OR' when any one of them does.

items.description: The conditions of this rule. Each one reads a single event property.

id.description: Stable id for the condition. Generated when omitted.

key.description: Event property the condition reads. One of: $raw_user_agent, $ip, $lib, $host, $pathname, $current_url, $browser, $os, $browser_language, $screen_width, $screen_height, $geoip_country_code, $referrer, $referring_domain.

matcher.description: How `pattern` is compared: 'contains' (case-insensitive substring), 'regex' (RE2), 'exact' (case-sensitive equality), or 'cidr' (an IP network range, only valid with the `$ip` property).

pattern.description: Value matched against the property named by `key`. For 'cidr' this is a network range like 192.0.2.0/24.

name.description: Label reported by the `Bot name` property when the rule matches. Also the operator for a rule on a bot PostHog does not know.
